{{Quote|It was to protect Admiral Ar'alani, the officer commanding the transport that arrived an hour ago to take the freed Geroon slaves back to their world.|Force Commander Thrawn|<ref name="OBF" />}}
'''Geroon'''<ref name="Planetnamia" /> was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Geroon (species)|Geroon]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. It was located in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]<ref name="OBF" /> [[Geroon system/Legends|Geroon system]].<ref name="Planetnamia" /> Around [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]],<ref name="ERC" /> it was [[Battle of Geroon|attacked]] by the [[Vagaari/Legends|Vagaari]] species. While the [[Vagaari slaver fleet|Vagaari forces]] fought the Geroon defenders, the [[Cruiser/Legends|Chiss assault cruiser]] [[Springhawk/Legends|''Springhawk'']] arrived, retrieving one of the [[Gravity well projector/Legends|Vagaari gravity field generators]] used to prevent the Geroon's escape to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]. The [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] fled while the Vagaari captured the planet and its people, who they used as [[Zero-g plastic bubble|living shields]] in their [[Vagaari warship|warships]].<ref name="OBF" />

Following the Vagaari capture of the world, [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Jorj Car'das]] traveled to the homeworld, where [[Gender/Legends|he]] met with the Vagaari leader, the [[Unidentified Miskara (Jorj Car'das)|Miskara]], aboard his [[The Miskara's flagship|ship]]. Aboard, Car'das informed him of the Chiss' location, and all the Vagaari traveled to the [[Crustai system/Legends|Crustai system]]. There, the Vagaari were [[Battle for Outbound Flight|destroyed]] by Chiss [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|droid starfighters]], which fired between the Vagaari shields. [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Ar'alani/Legends|Ar'alani]] of the [[Chiss Defense Fleet]] returned the freed Geroons aboard a [[Ar'alani's transport ship|transport ship]] to their world, which her forces freed.<ref name="OBF" />

In [[22 ABY/Legends|22 ABY]],<ref name="SQ date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Survivor's Quest]]'' to [[22 ABY/Legends|22 ABY]].</ref> during a [[First night's reception dinner (Chaf Envoy)|reception dinner]] held aboard the [[Cruiser|Chiss diplomatic cruiser]] ''[[Chaf Envoy]]'', [[Aide/Legends|Aide]] [[Chaf'ees'aklaio]], [[Core name/Legends|core name]] "Feesa," of the [[Chaf family/Legends|Fifth Ruling Family]] explained to [[Dean Jinzler]], that according to the [[First Steward]] [[Bearsh]] of the [[Geroon Remnant]]&mdash;who in reality was a [[General/Legends|General]] in the [[Vagaari Empire]]&mdash;[[wolvkil]]s were a feral [[Subspecies/Legends|subspecies]] of a [[Unidentified predator creature|predator creature]] native to Geroon. Jinzler felt revulsed by the fact that they kept wolvkils as pets and instead expressed his wish to never meet the creature in the woods. With sadness, Feesa assured Jinzler that would never happen, since the remaining wolvkils perished with their homeworld.<ref name="SQ" />
